note: The mechanism that unlocks and cycles the breech. Only meaningful for self-loading arms; `manual` covers everything cycled by hand.

terms.label: Gas, direct impingement
terms.description: Propellant gas acts on the bolt carrier without a separate piston.

terms.label: Gas, short-stroke piston
terms.description: A piston travels less than the full bolt stroke and separates from the carrier.

terms.label: Gas, long-stroke piston
terms.description: A piston fixed to the carrier travels the full stroke with it.

terms.label: Short recoil
terms.description: Barrel and breech recoil locked together briefly, then separate.

terms.label: Long recoil
terms.description: Barrel and breech recoil locked together the full stroke.

terms.label: Blowback, simple
terms.description: Breech held only by bolt mass and spring.

terms.label: Blowback, roller-delayed
terms.description: Rollers geared against the trunnion retard bolt opening.

terms.label: Blowback, gas-delayed
terms.description: Tapped gas pressure retards bolt opening.

terms.label: Blowback, lever-delayed
terms.description: A lever geared against the receiver retards bolt opening.

terms.label: Manually operated
terms.description: The shooter supplies the energy to cycle the breech.

terms.label: Externally powered
terms.description: Cycled by an external motor or crank rather than by firing.
